bio: Hundrik's cover story is he's the battle-brother of Elder King Thalbrennar, devoted to his lord's protection. The reality is rather different. He's really a covert spy, sent by the Deep Lords to act as a gentle whisper in the king's ear. Despite his true goal, he plays his part properly, crushing anyone who dare threaten his lord's life.
